errors_found: collect hlp: `d / "vault_%s.json.gz" % HLP` divided before formatting (TypeError); fixed with parentheses; the first background run recorded the part as failed, the snapshot was re-collected by a separate run
manifest race: two collect processes rewrote one manifest file; manifests are now one file per part
gains loader divided gUSDC totalSupply by 1e18; gToken shares carry the asset's 6 decimals
GMX squid collectedFeesInfos has no "1d" period (only "1h"/"total"): fees1d files are empty; the fee decomposition uses the daily aprSnapshots instead
Arbitrum block lookup by bisection cost ~25 calls a day; replaced by interpolation between 4M-block anchors plus a local-rate correction (blocks land within 10 minutes before midnight)

JLP source check first matched CoinGecko (00:00 UTC) and DefiLlama (~22:00 UTC) by calendar day, pairing prices 22 hours apart: daily-return correlation 0.04. Nearest-timestamp matching (median 1.75 h apart) gives 0.91

LLP first used modified Dietz on value = inflow - outflow + trade P&L; the pool churns $4B of internal flows on $83M, so the mid-period-flow assumption failed (test-half total +3.9% vs +5.7% from value/shares); the share price is primary
the verdict rule first called any positive vault with under $1M of room "watch" whatever its t; now watch needs t >= 1.5
the robustness grid (120-day hedge window) was added after JLP's 60-day and 120-day windows disagreed; it is applied to every daily vault and never used for selection, but it was not pre-registered
